verdicts.summary: The note's two stated hazards (bare status:null marking a success as stopped, stale completed item reused by a later boundary) are findings 0 and 1. I found no further ordering hazard.
A running item can't keep isCompacting true after the run ends. Both clients scope it to the active run id and the active phase.
verdicts.scenario: The adapter crashes or the process dies mid-compaction and leaves a running item. Web requires item.runId === activeRuntime.activeRunId plus a running, connecting or send-busy phase. Mobile requires activeRunId and an active runtime. Once the run is no longer active, neither client reports compacting, so a leftover running item stays inert.
